items.name: menu

items.name: native-select

items.name: number-field

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover

items.name: progress

items.name: radio-group

items.name: review-bar

items.name: score-ring

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: The scroll-area primitive.

items.name: select
items.title: Select

items.name: separator

items.name: settings

items.name: sheet

items.name: sidebar

items.name: skeleton

items.name: slider

items.name: source-note

items.name: tab-bar

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A semantic data table in a keyboard-scrollable region: caption, column and row headers, sortable headers with aria-sort, selectable rows.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs with keyboard arrows, Home and End, built on Radix Tabs.

items.name: text-link
items.title: Text Link
items.description: An inline link with an always-visible underline and a focus ring.

items.name: theme-parts
items.title: Theme Parts
items.description: The theme-parts primitive.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toasts from anywhere in the app: neutral, info and danger tones, an optional Undo action, polite and assertive live regions.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A row of toggles that belong together: single (a radio group) or multiple, one tab stop with arrow-key movement.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed (bold, favourite, mute), with aria-pressed.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label for a control on hover and keyboard focus, with a shortcut hint and a shared delay provider. Built on Radix Tooltip.

items.name: zoom-canvas
items.title: Zoom Canvas
items.description: The zoom-canvas primitive.

items.name: about-timeline
items.title: About, timeline
items.description: Company milestones by year: a heading and lead, then a vertical list of years with a title and a few lines.

items.name: activity-log
items.title: Activity log
items.description: A heading beside a timed log of work: time, actor, one-line event and a status badge per row, with an optional highlighted row that needs the reader and one action. Static, no animation.

items.name: app-access-detail
items.title: Operations, access detail
items.description: An access record with a copyable code, explicit validity, permissions and recorded history; unknown permissions remain distinct from an empty list.

items.name: app-assistant-approval
items.title: App, assistant approval
items.description: An action the assistant wants to take and needs a person to allow: title, why, scoped detail, a risk level and Approve / Deny buttons named after the action. Pending, approved and denied via the state prop.

items.name: app-assistant-composer
items.title: App, assistant composer
items.description: The box a person writes to an assistant in, drawn by ChatComposer (the one chat input): a rounded pill with + for files, attachments as chips and a round send. Five states set by the state prop: ready, filled, sending (send becomes a quiet stop), disabled (with a notice), over the length limit (red edge, count, a line on how to fix it). Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line; no hint line. hint is kept for stored pages and not drawn.

items.name: app-assistant-showcase
items.title: App, assistant showcase
items.description: Heading and link beside a mock assistant: thread, tool call, an approval with a recommended option, and a composer. A fixture UI, not interactive.

items.name: app-assistant-thread
items.title: App, assistant thread
items.description: A conversation with an assistant: drawn as the agent chat kit draws it (the person in a bubble on the right, the reply as plain text, no avatars or visible names), optional code, sources and a note under a turn (a staff correction), and four states. A log region; each turn is named by its speaker for screen readers. The state, height and fixed scroll options are props.

items.name: app-assistant-tool-call
items.title: App, assistant tool call
items.description: One tool call in an assistant thread: name, one-line summary and status, with the arguments and result in a disclosure. Four states; duration is text you supply.

items.name: app-auth-code
items.title: App, one-time code
items.description: Enter a six-digit code: six boxes that behave as one field. Typing moves forward, Backspace moves back, arrow keys move, pasting fills every box, and the first box asks for the one-time code autofill. Idle, verifying, error and resent states.

items.name: app-auth-reset
items.title: App, reset password
items.description: Ask for a password reset link: one email field, a send button, a confirmation that does not reveal whether the address has an account, a resend button, and idle, sending, sent and error states.

items.name: app-auth-signin
items.title: App, sign in
items.description: Sign in with email and password, or email and a code (signInWith code, with optional Continue with Google and Continue with Microsoft buttons, each in its provider colour mark): labelled fields with the right autocomplete, a button that shows or hides the password, a forgot link, and idle, sending and error states. Never submits unless the host gives it an action.

items.name: app-auth-signup
items.title: App, sign up
items.description: Create an account: name, email and a password with its rules, a required consent checkbox that names the terms and privacy links, and idle, sending, error and consent-missing states. The sentence a person agrees to is never replaced by a default.

items.name: app-billing-invoices
items.title: App, invoice list
items.description: A list of invoices as a table: number, date, amount, a status badge (paid, due, failed: always a word) and a download link named for its invoice that stays in view while the other columns scroll, and a failed invoice that can be paid again or have its card updated. Filled and empty states.

items.name: app-billing-plan
items.title: App, plan and usage
items.description: The current plan on one card: name, price, what is included, usage meters (native meter elements; the band is said in words at 70%, 90% and over the limit, and a limit without a number such as Unlimited draws no meter), and manage and upgrade actions. Active, trial and past-due states.

items.name: app-boards-kanban
items.title: App, kanban board
items.description: A board of columns with cards (title, assignee, due date, status flag). Every card has a Move menu that lists the other columns, so a card moves by keyboard; the move is announced and focus follows the card. Empty columns say so. Filled, empty, loading and error states.

items.name: app-comments-thread
items.title: App, comment thread
items.description: A discussion between people: comments with author and time, replies one level deep, a Reply button that opens a form under its comment (focus moves in and back), and a composer. Posting adds to the thread in place, clears the field and announces it. Filled, empty, posting and error states.

items.name: app-dashboard-chart
items.title: App, chart card
items.description: A chart card for a dashboard: a bar or line chart drawn as plain SVG from a short list of readings, a sentence that says what it shows, and a value axis, negative values below a zero line, and a data table behind a disclosure so nobody depends on the picture. Filled, empty, loading and error states.

items.name: app-dashboard-stats
items.title: App, stat panel row
items.description: A row of two to four figures for a dashboard: label, large value, the change with a sign and an arrow, and what it is measured against. A definition list for assistive tech, with loading and error states.

items.name: app-data-filters
items.title: App, filter bar
items.description: A search box and select filters above a list, active filters as removable chips with a clear-all, and a result count read from a list (one entry per filter removed) and announced politely. Focus moves on when a chip goes. The block filters nothing itself.

items.name: app-data-pagination
items.title: App, pagination
items.description: A pagination row: a summary built from the page, rows per page and the total (it changes with the page and is read out politely), previous and next, numbered pages with a gap marker, and aria-current. It moves the marker and the summary; the rows are the host's.

items.name: app-data-table
items.title: App, data table
items.description: A data table: sort buttons that order by what a column holds (text, numbers, dates; aria-sort), a first column that stays in view while the rest scrolls with an edge fade, comfortable or compact rows, optional row selection with select all, an announced count and bulk actions, and four states.

items.name: app-files-dropzone
items.title: App, upload drop zone
items.description: A drop zone that takes a real drop (it highlights while a file is over it, a drop never navigates the page, dropped names are listed and announced) with the file picker inside it, so dragging is never the only way in. Idle, dragging and error states.

items.name: app-files-list
items.title: App, file list with status
items.description: Files and where each one is: uploading (a native progress bar with its percentage), done, or failed with a reason and Retry. Retry restarts the row at a stated percentage, Remove deletes it; both name their file, keep focus in the list and are announced. Filled and empty.

items.name: app-notifications-inbox
items.title: App, notification inbox
items.description: An inbox of notifications grouped by day: unread items marked with a dot and the word, an unread count in a live region, All and Unread filters, and Mark all as read. Opening an item marks it read in place. Filled and empty states.

items.name: app-onboarding-checklist
items.title: App, setup checklist
items.description: A getting-started checklist with a progress bar and a count that follow the checkboxes. Each step has a title, a line of help and maybe one action. A completion message appears above the list when all are done; the list stays so a step can be unticked.

items.name: app-onboarding-steps
items.title: App, step wizard header
items.description: A step indicator for a multi-step flow: numbered steps that are done, current or upcoming (aria-current="step", the state also said in words for screen readers), the current step's text, and Back and Continue buttons that move through the steps in place.

items.name: app-onboarding-welcome
items.title: App, welcome screen
items.description: The first screen of an empty account: a greeting, one sentence on what happens next, one primary action, an optional secondary link, and two to four short tips. Built so there is exactly one obvious next step.

items.name: app-operations-summary
items.title: Operations, daily summary
items.description: A daily operational count line with an explicit attention message and source provenance. No counts are inferred.

items.name: app-scheduling-calendar
items.title: App, month calendar
items.description: A month as a table with its events, today marked in words, previous, next and today buttons, and an agenda list in narrow containers instead of a cramped grid. Filled, empty, loading and error states. Dates are ISO text; the block never reads the clock.

items.name: app-scheduling-slots
items.title: App, time-slot picker
items.description: Pick a time: days across, times down, as a keyboard grid (arrow keys, Home and End, Space picks). A taken slot says so in words, the choice is repeated in a status line, and idle, error, confirmed and empty states. Never submits.

items.name: app-search-results
items.title: App, search results
items.description: A results page: a search box, checkbox facets whose counts follow the other filters, active filters as removable chips, a result count that is announced when it changes, and a no-results state with suggestions. Filled, empty, loading and error states.

items.name: app-settings-danger
items.title: App, danger zone
items.description: Irreversible actions kept apart from the rest of the settings. Each row explains the consequence; its button opens a confirmation where the person types a phrase before the destructive button is enabled. A host acts through onConfirm(index) (a promise: the button holds, then the done text, or the error text with the confirmation left open).

items.name: app-settings-notifications
items.title: App, notification preferences
items.description: A list of notification preferences, each a title, one line of explanation and a switch (applies at once) or a checkbox (saved with a button). The on/off state of every row is a prop.

items.name: app-settings-profile
items.title: App, profile settings
items.description: A profile form: photo, labelled fields with hints and autofill hints, save and cancel, and four states (idle; saving, which disables every field; saved; error, which marks and describes the flagged field). Never submits.

items.name: app-shell-sidebar
items.title: App, sidebar navigation
items.description: The sidebar of an app: grouped links with icons and an optional count, groups that open and close, the current page marked with aria-current, and a button that folds it into an icon rail whose names appear in tooltips (on hover and keyboard focus).

items.name: app-shell-topbar
items.title: App, top bar
items.description: The top bar of an app: breadcrumbs (the last is the current page, aria-current) and an account menu on an avatar button that opens with Enter, Space or the arrow keys, lists the account actions and returns focus on Escape.

items.name: app-sidebar-grouped
items.title: App sidebar, grouped
items.description: An app's side navigation as chrome beside every page: the product's name, an optional search field, places in up to four groups of six (a group can open and close), and the signed-in person at the foot. On a phone it folds into a menu.

items.name: app-team-invite
items.title: App, invite form
items.description: Invite someone: an email field with a hint, a role select and a send button, with four states (idle, sending, sent, error with the field marked and described). Sends only through onInvite(email, role) from its host (a promise: sending while it runs, sent or the error banner after); without one it previews.

items.name: app-team-members
items.title: App, member list
items.description: The people on a team: avatar, name, email and a role select per member, a locked owner row, Remove with a confirmation that keeps focus in the list, role changes and removals announced by name, a count that follows, and an empty state.

items.name: app-team-pending
items.title: App, pending invites
items.description: Invites not yet accepted: address, role and when it was sent, with Resend and Revoke that name their invite. Revoke asks first and keeps focus in the list; both actions are shown and announced with the address; the count follows; empty state.

items.name: banner-announcement
items.title: Banner, announcement
items.description: A slim bar above the navbar with one sentence, a link and a dismiss button.

items.name: banner-cookie
items.title: Banner, cookie notice
items.description: A cookie notice with accept and reject buttons and a link to the policy.

items.name: banner-cta-bar
items.title: Banner, call-to-action bar
items.description: A bar docked at the end of the page with a headline, a sentence and two actions. A last nudge after the content, not a notice. Empty secondary label drops that button.

items.name: banner-promo
items.title: Banner, promo code
items.description: A slim bar above the navbar for a campaign: a short badge, one line of text, the discount code in a dashed chip, and a link. Empty badge or code drops that part.

items.name: blog-cards
items.title: Blog, cards
items.description: A grid of article cards with image, category, title, excerpt and date, plus a link to all posts.

items.name: blog-list
items.title: Blog, list
items.description: Post rows with date, title, excerpt and category, plus a link to the full archive.

items.name: blog-post
items.title: Blog, post
items.description: An article: category, title, date and reading time, author, cover image and a reading column of body text.

items.name: booking-alternating-rows
items.title: Booking, alternating rows
items.description: A centred heading over rows in cards, each a picture beside text with the picture alternating sides. A row can be an event with points, time and place and buttons, an offer with a tag, price and button, or a small form. On a phone each row stacks, picture first.

items.name: booking-offset-form
items.title: Booking, offset form
items.description: A heading with label and lead at the top left, a picture with a caption stepping down to the right, and a booking form (selects and text fields, a main and a second action, a legal line) stepping back to the left, in one diagonal flow. On a phone the three parts stack in that order.

items.name: booking-pinned-header
items.title: Booking, pinned header
items.description: A heading column (label, heading, lead) that stays pinned at the left while the right column scrolls a picture with a caption and one booking card: the item with badge, description, price and checklist, day and time pills, a short summary, a form with a main and a second action, tags with a rating, a question and links. On a phone the heading sits above the column.

items.name: careers-roles
items.title: Careers, open roles
items.description: Open roles grouped by team: a heading per team, and under it one row per role with its title, location, type and a Remote word where it applies, and a link that names its role. Each team is a labelled section.

items.name: case-study-before-after
items.title: Case study, before and after
items.description: One dated result: client, a metric name, a before and an after figure, a short story, a link and an image.

items.name: case-study-card
items.title: Case studies, cards
items.description: A collection of up to twelve project cards in a responsive three-column grid: image, client, a headline figure with its label, a short summary and a link. featured makes the first one a full-width lead card with its picture beside the text.

items.name: case-study-metrics
items.title: Case study, metrics
items.description: One customer story led by its numbers: headline and summary, a row of two to four big metrics, then a quote beside a photo and a link to the full story.

items.name: case-study-problem-solution
items.title: Case-study, problem solution
items.description: A centred heading and line, then a framed picture on the left and short titled parts with one button on the right; on a phone the picture sits above the text.

items.name: case-study-story
items.title: Case study, story
items.description: A narrative case study: headline, one wide photo, then two to four chapters side by side (Challenge, Approach, Result). Words first, no figure wall.

items.name: changelog-compact
items.title: Changelog, compact list
items.description: A dense changelog: one row per change with date, a tag in words and a title that links to the entry. For a sidebar-sized "what is new" or a page that lists many releases. A link at the end goes to the full list.

items.name: changelog-timeline
items.title: Changelog, timeline
items.description: A changelog as a vertical timeline: each entry has a date (with an optional version), a title, a paragraph, tags in words and a short list of changes. Entries are articles with the date as a time heading. A link at the end goes to the full history; leave its label empty to drop it.

items.name: comparison-cards
items.title: Comparison, who it is for
items.description: Two or three cards that each say who a choice is right for ("Choose us if", "Choose a spreadsheet if") with a few reasons, and an optional honest closing line. For comparisons where the answer depends on the reader, not a feature count.

items.name: comparison-table
items.title: Comparison, us versus them
items.description: A table comparing you with one to three alternatives, feature by feature. Each cell says Included, Not included or Partly in words beside its icon. The header stays in view while the table scrolls, the feature column stays beside the others, and a caption appears when columns are cut off. For plans against plans use the pricing block.

items.name: contact-accordion-rows
items.title: Contact, accordion rows
items.description: A label, heading and lead beside a picture, then ways to get in touch stacked beneath as rows that open on a tap, each showing a line, a detail and one action. The first row starts open. On a phone the heading sits above the picture and each row stacks its action under its text.

items.name: contact-area
items.title: Contact, area served
items.description: Where a business that travels to its customers works: a heading, how far and how fast they come, the town they work from and one call button on one side, the places they cover as a ruled list (with a note per place) on the other. No map picture needed. For trades, cleaners, mobile services and delivery.

items.name: contact-bands
items.title: Contact, bands
items.description: Three full-width bands one after another: a header (label, heading and lead), a tinted band with a picture and caption beside a card of badge, place, address, contact links and three actions, then a band with a short heading beside opening hours as ruled rows and a small note. On a phone each band stacks into one column.

items.name: contact-banner-details
items.title: Contact, banner and details
items.description: A wide picture first, then a headline with actions and two detail blocks, an address with phone and email and a list of opening hours. Centered stacks the intro over two cards; split puts the intro and details left and the actions right. On a phone everything stacks in one column.

items.name: contact-banner-form
items.title: Contact, banner and form card
items.description: A wide picture band across the top, then the label, heading, lead, a paragraph, labelled details in two columns and a row of links on the left, and on the right a card with a one-field form and two buttons under it. On a phone the card follows the text.

items.name: contact-booking
items.title: Contact, booking
items.description: Contact options beside a card of static time slots to pick from, the name and email of who is booking, and a confirm button.

items.name: contact-booking-link
items.title: Contact, booking link
items.description: A card for booking a call in an external calendar: the person (photo, name, role), how long it is, what happens in the call, one primary link to the calendar page, and an email for people who prefer that. No time slots are drawn: the calendar owns them.

items.name: contact-channels
items.title: Contact, channels
items.description: Two to four ways to reach you as cards: an icon, the channel name, who it is for, the address or number as a link, and how fast you answer. For support pages and anywhere "contact us" is really a choice.

items.name: contact-form
items.title: Contact, form
items.description: Heading and contact details beside a simple message form. Presentation only: the page wires the submit.

items.name: contact-form-grid
items.title: Contact, form grid
items.description: A centred contact section: a two-part heading and a short line, then fields in two columns, a full-width message, and a row with a terms tick box and a send button. One column on a phone.

items.name: contact-map
items.title: Contact, address and map
items.description: A visit page in two halves: the address, an opening-hours list, phone and email on one side, a map image with a directions link on the other. For a shop, studio or restaurant that people come to.

items.name: contact-minimal
items.title: Contact, minimal
items.description: Typographic contact: one oversized email link as the call to action, then up to three quiet details (phone, visit, hours) in columns. No form, no map.

items.name: contact-mosaic-tiles
items.title: Contact, mosaic tiles
items.description: Five tiles in a mosaic: a heading card, a tinted band of actions beneath it, a tall captioned picture beside both, then an opening-hours card and a wider details card with a picture. On a phone the tiles stack in one column.

items.name: contact-offices
items.title: Contact, offices
items.description: Where to find us: one card per office or shop (up to eight) with address, its own opening hours (a line per run of days), email, phone and a directions link. No form, no map picture. Email and phone become links; leave a field empty to drop the line.

items.name: contact-overlap-card
items.title: Contact, overlap card
items.description: A large picture across seven of twelve columns with a card overlapping its right edge, holding a label, heading, lead, address, phone and email lines, two buttons and a quiet third link. On a phone the card slides up over the picture's lower edge.

items.name: contact-overlay-aside
items.title: Contact, overlay aside
items.description: A wide picture with the heading laid over its foot beside a narrow ruled card holding the lead, address, phone and email, a one-field form, three actions and a profile link with the legal line. On a phone the picture sits above the card.

items.name: contact-pair-pictures
items.title: Contact, pair of pictures
items.description: Two pictures side by side on top, then a centred label, heading and line, a row of email and phone links, and two buttons beneath. No form. On a phone the pictures stack.

items.name: contact-split-details
items.title: Contact, split with details
items.description: The label, heading, lead and two buttons at the start beside a captioned picture, then under a thin rule two plain columns: the address, phone and email, and the opening hours with the day beside its time. On a phone everything stacks. With no picture (empty src) none is drawn and the text column takes the row.

items.name: contact-visual-panel
items.title: Contact, picture panel
items.description: A heading with its label and lead, a large rounded picture under it, and a white card on the picture at its lower left holding a name, icon lines for address, phone, date or time, optional opening hours and buttons. The buttons sit in the card or at the end of the heading row.

items.name: content-columns
items.title: Content, columns
items.description: Long text set in two newspaper columns under a wide headline, with an optional large pull quote between them. For a manifesto or an essay on a wide page.

items.name: content-legal
items.title: Content, policy document
items.description: A policy or terms page: title and last-updated line, a sticky contents list that jumps to numbered sections (plain anchors, no script), and the sections themselves.

items.name: content-offset
items.title: Content, offset
items.description: A large heading at the top left and one long paragraph in a narrower column set well to the right and lower down, with open space on the left; on a phone the paragraph sits under the heading at full width.

items.name: content-prose
items.title: Content, prose
items.description: A reading column: title, lead paragraph, then headed sections of body text. For about pages and articles.

items.name: content-split-text
items.title: Content, text and perks card
items.description: A heading and a few short paragraphs on the left, a bordered card on the right with up to four icon, title and description points. On a phone the card sits under the text and each icon sits above its title.

items.name: content-statement
items.title: Content, statement
items.description: One large statement of three or four lines, set left in a narrow measure on a tinted band: a pause between sections.

items.name: cta-audiences
items.title: Call to action, by audience
items.description: Two or three side-by-side cards, one per kind of visitor (for guests, for owners, for agencies), each with its own short pitch, up to three points and its own action. The first card is filled. For a site with more than one front door.

items.name: cta-band
items.title: Call to action, band
items.description: A contrasting panel with a short headline and one or two actions, to close a page.

items.name: cta-card
items.title: Call to action, card
items.description: A contained, rounded card with a centred headline, two actions and a row of short reassurances (no card needed, cancel any time). Sits inside the page column instead of spanning it.

items.name: cta-figure
items.title: Cta, figure
items.description: A short dark closing band: one giant figure in the display font on the left and a single small underlined text link with an arrow beneath it. On a phone the figure scales down and the link stays under it.

items.name: cta-media
items.title: Call to action, over an image
items.description: A wide image with a solid panel laid over its lower left corner holding the headline, a sentence and two actions (stacked under the image on narrow screens). Lets a photograph carry the mood: a place, a product, a crowd, with text that never depends on the image colours.

items.name: cta-minimal
items.title: Call to action, minimal
items.description: Type only: an oversized headline between two hairlines and one arrow link, nothing else. For a quiet end of page, or between long sections. Empty hint hides the small line.

items.name: cta-offer
items.title: CTA, offer
items.description: The offer of the week as one block: what you get in three to five points, how fast (text), this week's limit (text), and one primary action that is either a link or a one-field form. No countdown, no clock: swapping the offer is editing text.

items.name: cta-scattered
items.title: Call to action, scattered pictures
items.description: A centred call to action (label, heading, lead and two actions) with small pictures scattered around all four sides of the section: four on a phone, eight on a wide screen.

items.name: cta-split
items.title: Call to action, split
items.description: A panel with a headline, one or two actions and an image beside the copy.

items.name: directory-cards
items.title: Directory, cards
items.description: A heading and a grid of link cards with thumbnail, title, caption, meta and an optional tag or actions. Catalogue cards, groups with "View all", category and template grids.

items.name: directory-header
items.title: Directory, header
items.description: Title and description of a catalogue page, with optional breadcrumbs, search field, select labels and filter chips. Presentation only: the site wires search and sort.

items.name: directory-preview
items.title: Directory, preview
items.description: Full-width preview of one block or screen: breadcrumbs, title, status badge, viewport toggle, Preview and Code tabs, actions and a framed stage that renders a registered demo by id.

items.name: directory-template-info
items.title: Directory, template info
items.description: What a template contains: the pages it includes (name and path), the blocks it uses as chips, and a paragraph on how to customise it.

items.name: docs-anatomy
items.title: Docs, anatomy
items.description: A diagram or live demo beside the part tree and part list of a compound component.

items.name: docs-customise
items.title: Docs, customise panel
items.description: The component-page customise panel: a stage and its code beside a list of controls (select, toggle, text). The layout is static; the site wires the controls to the code.

items.name: docs-do-dont
items.title: Docs, do and don't
items.description: Side-by-side do and don't pairs, each with a short rule and an example image.

items.name: docs-examples
items.title: Docs, examples
items.description: Named example groups (Variants, Sizes, States, With icon, Composition), each a stage (live demo or image) with optional code beneath.

items.name: docs-header
items.title: Docs, page header
items.description: Breadcrumbs, title and description, with an optional status badge, install command and result preview (demo or image). Opens a documentation page.

items.name: docs-install
items.title: Docs, install panel
items.description: An install panel: tabs of copyable code (CLI, Manual, Download), an optional "Uses" chip row, short labelled facts and actions. A tab with no code is left out.

items.name: docs-pager
items.title: Docs, pager
items.description: Previous and next cards that close a documentation page, with optional actions (Copy for AI, Edit on GitHub) and a last-updated line. A card with no title is left out.

items.name: docs-preview-frame
items.title: Docs, preview frame
items.description: A framed live stage and its code, with Preview and Code tabs when both are present. The stage is a live demo (demo id) or an image; either part may be left out (code-only SKILL.md, preview-only expected result).

items.name: docs-prompt
items.title: Docs, prompt
items.description: A prompt to copy, with {variables} highlighted. The first action copies the prompt; the others are links (Open in Claude, ChatGPT, v0). An optional result image shows what it produced.

items.name: docs-props-table
items.title: Docs, props table
items.description: A table of a component API: name, type, default and description. Scrolls sideways in narrow containers.

items.name: docs-related
items.title: Docs, related links
items.description: A titled row of link chips: the blocks a page uses, related components.

items.name: docs-swatches
items.title: Docs, colour swatches
items.description: A grid of colour swatches with name, hex value and token. The colour foundation specimen. Only hex values paint a swatch.

items.name: docs-table
items.title: Docs, table
items.description: A titled table with free columns (tokens, keyboard keys, variables, changelog). A column renders as text, code or badge; the first cell of each row is its header.

items.name: download-apps
items.title: Download, mobile app
items.description: Get the mobile app: a headline, one to three store buttons (each a link with the store named in text), a QR code with a caption for people on a desktop, and an optional line about requirements. The QR image is a Media slot; the buttons never depend on it.

items.name: download-desktop
items.title: Download, desktop builds
items.description: Desktop builds side by side: one card per platform with version, what it runs on, size and a download link that names its platform, then the system requirements for each platform as definition lists. Nothing is detected, so every build is always offered.

items.name: error-links
items.title: Error, with links
items.description: A not-found or error page that does not leave people stranded: code, plain explanation, one primary action, and a short list of described places to go next. Left-aligned, two columns when wide.

items.name: error-maintenance
items.title: Error, maintenance
items.description: A planned-downtime page: a status pill, headline, when we are back, and a short log of timed updates. Centred, calm, no error code. Empty updates hide the log.

items.name: error-page
items.title: Error page
items.description: A 404, 500 or maintenance page: status code, headline, explanation and two ways out.

items.name: error-status
items.title: Error, server error
items.description: A 500-style page for when it is our fault: plain apology, retry and status actions, and a side panel with a copyable reference id for support plus up to three things to try.

items.name: faq-banner-list
items.title: FAQ, banner and list
items.description: A wide picture band with the label, heading, lead and one action over its lower left, and a narrow ruled list of questions that open to show the answer beneath it. On a phone the band keeps its shape and the list stays one column.

items.name: faq-centered
items.title: FAQ, centred cards
items.description: A centred heading over a narrow column of questions, each in its own rounded card that opens on click, and one link at the bottom. Gentler than the ruled list and good for short sets of three to six.

items.name: faq-columns
items.title: FAQ, columns
items.description: Up to eight questions with their answers always open, laid out in two columns.

items.name: faq-grouped
items.title: FAQ, grouped
items.description: Questions organised under named topics (billing, setup, privacy). Each topic is a labelled row with its own accordion beside it. Use when you have more than eight questions.

items.name: faq-list
items.title: FAQ, list
items.description: A heading with a ruled list of questions that open to show the answer: beside the list, stacked above it, or stacked and centred over a narrower list.

items.name: faq-numbered-cards
items.title: FAQ, numbered cards
items.description: A left-aligned header over a hairline, then every question and answer open in its own numbered, bordered card, three to a row on wide containers and one on a phone, and an action row under a second hairline.

items.name: faq-picture-beside
items.title: FAQ, picture beside
items.description: A header on top, then a tall rounded picture on the left and a ruled list of questions that open to show the answer on the right, with one action under the list. On a phone the picture sits above the list.

items.name: faq-rows
items.title: FAQ, question and answer rows
items.description: Every answer open, set as a table of rows: the question is a heading on the left, the answer beside it on the right, hairlines between. Nothing to click, so it prints and scans well; stacks on narrow containers.

items.name: faq-support
items.title: FAQ, with a support card
items.description: An accordion of questions beside a raised "still stuck?" card with up to three ways to reach a person and one action. For products where the real answer is often a conversation.

items.name: features-bento
items.title: Features, bento
items.description: A mixed-size tile grid of up to seven features. Medium and large tiles carry an image, small tiles stay text-only. Pair a large tile with a small one.

items.name: features-bento-cards
items.title: Features, bento cards
items.description: A centred heading and line over a bento grid of bordered cards in three rows: a tall picture card beside two icon cards, a wide picture card with a full-width button, then two icon cards beside a tall picture card. Every row stacks on a phone.

items.name: features-bento-pictures
items.title: Features, bento pictures
items.description: A heading with a lead and two actions beside it, then a bento of picture cards: a large card beside a medium card and a solid number tile, and a small card beside a wide card with its picture at the side. On a phone the cards stack in one column.

items.name: features-grid
items.title: Features, grid
items.description: Optional section heading and a grid of up to nine features, each with an optional icon, a title and a short description. Two to four columns.

items.name: features-image-cards
items.title: Features, image cards
items.description: Section heading with up to two buttons at its right, and two to six equal cards, each a picture on top with a small badge, a title, a line and a text link; three in a row on a wide container, or one row that scrolls sideways.

items.name: features-list
items.title: Features, list
items.description: Heading and a link on the left, a vertical list of up to six features with icon, title and description on the right.

items.name: features-showcase
items.title: Features, showcase
items.description: A centred stack in one column: heading, a sentence and up to two buttons, then one wide picture under them. For a product or plan shown whole, mid-page.

items.name: features-split
items.title: Features, alternating
items.description: Feature rows with copy beside an image, alternating sides. Each row has a title, description and up to four points.

items.name: features-stacked-cards
items.title: Features, stacked cards
items.description: An intro column (eyebrow, heading, lead, two actions) pinned beside a tall column of picture cards, each with a badge, name and line. On a phone the intro sits above the stacked cards.

items.name: features-tabs
items.title: Features, tabs
items.description: Two to five tabs, each with a title, description, a short list of points and an image. All panels show while editing.

items.name: features-tabs-cards
items.title: Features, tab cards
items.description: A left-aligned heading and lead above a numbered list of cards at the left, the first open with its line, and one picture with a caption at the right that follows the open card. Works without script; on a phone the picture sits under the list.

items.name: features-terminal
items.title: Features, terminal
items.description: Section heading and a link beside a terminal command and a prompt box. The section version of hero-terminal (h2).

items.name: feed-masonry
items.title: Feed, two columns
items.description: A heading and a line over two columns of cards, each a picture as tall as its shape with a caption and a small arrow under it, fading out at the bottom. Use to show a body of work or many examples at a glance.

items.name: floating-actions
items.title: Floating actions
items.description: A pill with a quiet link and the main action, centred on its own band so the one thing to do stays in reach. Sits in the flow of its section, never fixed over the page. Empty secondary label drops the link.

items.name: footer-centered
items.title: Footer, centered
items.description: A centred footer: brand and one-line tagline, a row of page links, a row of social links, then the legal line. For sites with five or six pages and no need for link columns.

items.name: footer-columns
items.title: Footer, columns
items.description: Up to six link columns, with a brand column or a full-width SVG wordmark below, an optional newsletter form, an optional contact block (address, hours), social links, badges and one button, an optional family row of sister sites and a legal line with legal links underneath.

items.name: footer-cta
items.title: Footer, with a call to action
items.description: A footer that opens with one last ask: a large headline, a sentence and two buttons on a tinted panel, then the brand, two to four link columns and the legal row. Saves a separate call-to-action section on short pages.

items.name: footer-simple
items.title: Footer, simple
items.description: One quiet row: brand, a few links and a legal line.

items.name: footer-status
items.title: Footer, with system status
items.description: A compact footer for a product: brand and tagline, a status pill (a dot, the words "All systems operational" and a link to the status page), one wrapped row of links and the legal line. The dot is shown by shape as well as colour. No columns.

items.name: footer-wordmark
items.title: Footer, wordmark
items.description: A footer led by an SVG text wordmark that scales to the full container width without wrapping or cropping, with up to three short link columns above and a legal row. Brand names up to 16 characters.

items.name: gallery-featured
items.title: Gallery, featured
items.description: One large lead image beside a stacked column of two or three smaller ones, each with a caption. A guided look: start here, then these.

items.name: gallery-grid
items.title: Gallery, grid
items.description: A grid of images with captions under a heading, filled row by row. columns "2" keeps pairs side by side, such as before and after. Give items a price and a note to show things for sale.

items.name: gallery-masonry
items.title: Gallery, masonry
items.description: Images in balanced columns with mixed frame shapes (wide, square, tall) and a caption under each. Use when the pictures are not all the same crop. Empty caption hides the line.

items.name: gallery-mosaic
items.title: Gallery, mosaic
items.description: Photos edge to edge with no gaps on a three-column grid, one and two columns wide in turn, so each pair of rows reads as a mosaic. Stacked full width on a phone.

items.name: gallery-scattered
items.title: Gallery, scattered pictures
items.description: A centred label, heading, lead and two buttons in the middle of a tall section, with four rounded pictures of different sizes scattered round them at the corners. On a phone the text comes first and the pictures follow in two columns.

items.name: gallery-stepped
items.title: Gallery, stepped diagonal
items.description: Three captioned pictures stepping down and across in a diagonal, with the label, heading, line, two buttons and a quiet underlined link tucked into the space at the lower left. On a phone the pictures and the text stack, each picture nudged a little further in.

items.name: gallery-strip
items.title: Gallery, scroll strip
items.description: A single row of same-height images that scrolls sideways with snap points and keyboard focus. Takes little height, so it fits between sections. The label names the region for screen readers.

items.name: gallery-thumbs
items.title: Gallery, thumbs
items.description: A header row (label, heading, lead) with two actions beside it, then one large wide picture with a caption and a strip of thumbnails beneath; choosing a thumbnail swaps the large picture, with no script. On a phone the actions sit under the header.

items.name: hero-actions-first
items.title: Hero, actions first
items.description: A strip across the top with the buttons on the left and a plain link on the right, then a large centred heading with its lead, and a wide picture with a caption under it.

items.name: hero-bento-cells
items.title: Hero, bento cells
items.description: An uneven mosaic of cells on a twelve-part grid: a tall heading cell, a picture, two large-figure cells, a wide picture and a small card with the buttons. Two columns on a tablet, one on a phone.

items.name: hero-card-cover
items.title: Hero, card cover
items.description: A full-width picture with one centred card over it holding a small label, the heading, one line and two actions. The card keeps its width on a phone and the actions stack.

items.name: hero-centered
items.title: Hero, centered
items.description: Centered headline, description and two actions, with a wide framed image below.

items.name: hero-code
items.title: Hero, install command
items.description: Centered headline with a copyable install command and two links. For developer tools and libraries.

items.name: hero-cover
items.title: Hero, cover
items.description: Their own photo full-bleed under a dark scrim, with their name or wordmark logo, one line, an optional real rating and one or two buttons on it (the second in the brand's second colour), centred or at the foot. Text stays light in either colour mode. For a bakery, salon, restaurant or shop whose own site opens on a dark photo.

items.name: hero-diagonal
items.title: Hero, diagonal
items.description: Three steps down a diagonal on a wide screen: a large heading with its lead at the top left, the actions on a row in the middle, offset to the right, and a picture at the lower right. One column on a phone.

items.name: hero-facts
items.title: Hero, facts
items.description: A hero with no picture: one large sentence, a thin rule, then two to four facts stacked under it, each a small label, a large value and an optional link (the next date and tickets, where, opening hours, a price from). For an event, a venue, a practice or a trade whose page opens on what a visitor needs to know. The same stack on a phone.

items.name: hero-figure
items.title: Hero, figure
items.description: A dark full-height hero where one giant figure in the display font fills the lower right, with a small label top-left, a short note top-right and the headline small at the bottom-left. On a phone the label, note and headline stack at the top and the figure sits at the bottom.

items.name: hero-flanked-media
items.title: Hero, flanked picture
items.description: A centred heading, then one picture in the middle with a button on each side of it. On a phone the second action, the picture and the main action stack in that order.

items.name: hero-floating-media
items.title: Hero, floating pictures
items.description: A large two-line heading, its second line in the accent, a short line and a row of chips, with pictures floating around it at different sizes.

items.name: hero-frame
items.title: Hero, framed screenshot
items.description: Centred headline and actions above a product screenshot in a window frame with a title bar.

items.name: hero-header-row
items.title: Hero, header row
items.description: A heading and a short lead on the left with the actions on the same row at the right, and a wide picture below, with an optional caption. On a phone the actions stack under the lead, full width, and the picture follows.

items.name: hero-media-bookends
items.title: Hero, picture on both ends
items.description: One column: a wide picture, then a centred label, heading, lead and two buttons, then a second wide picture with a caption under it.

items.name: hero-media-foot
items.title: Hero, picture over a foot row
items.description: A large picture across the top, then a foot row with a label, a heading and a short line on one side and the actions on the other. On a phone the foot stacks under the picture, text first and actions last.

items.name: hero-minimal
items.title: Hero, minimal
items.description: Oversized headline, one line of description and a single link, left-aligned or centred, optionally filling the screen. No media.

items.name: hero-panel-tiles
items.title: Hero, panel tiles
items.description: A calm opener: a tall white panel with a label, a big title, a lead and two actions at its foot, beside a mosaic of tiles (a picture, a number, an icon or captioned pictures). On a phone the panel comes first and the tiles stack under it, two to a row.

items.name: hero-prompt
items.title: Hero, prompt
items.description: Centred headline with a prompt input as the call to action and suggestion chips. For AI products.

items.name: hero-prompt-box
items.title: Hero, prompt box
items.description: A large dark prompt box with a round send arrow, a row of suggestion chips under it, then a filled button beside a plain link; the two actions stack on a phone.

items.name: hero-split
items.title: Hero, split
items.description: Headline, short description and two actions on the left; an image on the right. Stacks in narrow containers.

items.name: hero-split-grid
items.title: Hero, two by two
items.description: A two-by-two grid: the heading and lead top left, a picture top right, a short paragraph with the buttons bottom left and a second picture bottom right. One column on a phone, in reading order.

items.name: hero-split-mosaic
items.title: Hero, split mosaic
items.description: Two unequal columns of cells: the text, a small picture and the actions down the wide left column, and a tall picture over a card of two figures in the right column. On a phone it is one column in reading order without the tall picture.

items.name: hero-terminal
items.title: Hero, terminal
items.description: Headline and actions beside a terminal panel (command and output) and a prompt box. For developer and agent products.

items.name: hero-twin-pictures
items.title: Hero, twin pictures
items.description: Two columns side by side, each with a label, a heading, a picture with a caption and a name line, then one ruled row under both with a plain link on the left and the buttons on the right. The columns stack on a phone.

items.name: hero-url-form
items.title: Hero, url form
items.description: A centred hero: a small pill badge, a large two-line heading, a line under it, then a label and one wide rounded input for a web address with a submit button. On a phone the heading wraps to three lines and the input fills the width.

items.name: integrations-featured
items.title: Integrations, featured
items.description: One integration told in full (logo, tagline, what it does, a list of highlights and an action) beside a short list of the others, each a single link. For the integration most customers ask about.

items.name: integrations-grid
items.title: Integrations, filterable grid
items.description: A grid of integrations, each with a logo, name, one line and a link, and filter chips built from the groups (All, Payments, Calendars, ...). The chips are native radios the block stylesheet reads, so the filter works with no script; the count follows the filter. Leave a link label empty to drop that link.

items.name: logos-detail-picker
items.title: Logos, detail picker
items.description: A header (label, heading, lead) over two columns: a list of selectable logo rows on the left and one detail panel on the right (picture, badge, heading, text, two actions) that changes with the chosen row, with no script. On a phone the list sits above the panel.

items.name: logos-featured
items.title: Logos, with quote
items.description: One customer quote on the left, a framed grid of up to six customer logos on the right. Names without artwork are set as wordmarks. Social proof in one screenful.

items.name: logos-grid
items.title: Logos, grid
items.description: A hairline grid of up to 48 logo cells. Each cell shows its image, or the name set as a wordmark while there is no image.

items.name: logos-grouped
items.title: Logos, by sector
items.description: Customer names set as wordmarks in columns under a sector heading (hotels, restaurants, agencies), two to four groups. Shows the breadth of who uses you, which a single row cannot. No logo files needed.

items.name: logos-press
items.title: Logos, as seen in
items.description: Press coverage as rows: the outlet as a wordmark on the left, the headline as a link to the article, the year at the right. Proof from third parties, with the receipts one click away.

items.name: logos-results
items.title: Logos, with results
items.description: Each customer as a small card: logo (or wordmark), one headline result and what it measures. Proof with numbers instead of a plain row of names.

items.name: logos-row-around-heading
items.title: Logos, row around heading
items.description: A centred row of logos on top, then a centred heading with one action beneath it, and optionally a second logo row under the action. Logos wrap on a phone.

items.name: logos-split-grid
items.title: Logos, heading beside grid
items.description: Two columns: the heading with up to two actions on the left, a grid of framed logo tiles on the right (two across on a phone, three on a wide container). Names without artwork are set as wordmarks.

items.name: logos-strip
items.title: Logos strip
items.description: A quiet line of customer or partner names under a short lead-in and an optional description. Names are set as wordmarks.

items.name: logos-tile-heading
items.title: Logos, heading tile
items.description: One hairline-framed grid in which the first tile holds the heading and an action and the rest hold logos (three across on a wide container, two on a phone, the heading tile full width). Names without artwork are set as wordmarks.

items.name: navbar-centered
items.title: Navbar, centred
items.description: Brand centred with the links split either side, a secondary link and one call to action. Collapses to a menu in narrow containers.

items.name: navbar-corners
items.title: Navbar, corners
items.description: Brand top-left and links top-right above a wide picture, with the call to action bottom-left and a menu icon link bottom-right laid over the picture. On a phone the picture is taller and the row above wraps.

items.name: navbar-dot-rail
items.title: Navbar, dot rail
items.description: No bar: a slim vertical column of dots on the right edge of its section, centred top to bottom, each a link whose label shows to the left on hover or focus. The current dot is filled in the accent colour.

items.name: navbar-menu
items.title: Navbar, menu panels
items.description: Brand, up to four link groups that open a panel of described links, and one call to action. Panels become sections of the mobile menu.

items.name: navbar-overlay-menu
items.title: Navbar, overlay menu
items.description: A bar that stays collapsed at every width, brand with a menu toggle (or toggle, brand and a round icon link), opening a panel of large links and actions under the bar with no script.

items.name: navbar-search
items.title: Navbar, search
items.description: A shop header: the brand, a wide rounded search field, round account and basket buttons, then a row of category links under a rule. On a phone the search drops to its own full-width line and the links wrap.

items.name: navbar-sidebar
items.title: Navbar, sidebar
items.description: Navigation as a left column: the brand on top, stacked links and a button at the bottom, with an optional heading and lead in the content beside it. With the top bar on, a full-width bar with the brand, a search field and an initials chip sits above, and the link column drops below it. On a phone the column goes above the content and the links wrap in a row.

items.name: navbar-simple
items.title: Navbar, simple
items.description: Brand on the left, up to eight links, an optional search trigger, secondary link, language link and theme toggle, and one call to action. An optional Products disclosure holds short descriptions and status labels. Collapses to a menu in narrow containers.

items.name: navbar-tabbar
items.title: Navbar, tabbar
items.description: A row of three to five equally spaced tabs, each an icon above a short label, as native links with the current one marked and filled. It is drawn in the section, a bar with a top rule, never fixed to the screen.

items.name: navbar-utility
items.title: Navbar, utility bar
items.description: Two rows: a slim tinted utility bar (a note on the left, phone, language or sign-in links on the right) above the main row with brand, up to six links and one call to action. The main row collapses to a menu in narrow containers; the utility bar stays.

items.name: navbar-utility-open
items.title: Navbar, open utility strip
items.description: Two rows with every link open at every width: a plain top strip with up to three text links, a search field and one social icon, above the main row with the brand, the links centred and one call to action. On a phone both rows stay and the links wrap, with no menu.

items.name: newsletter-card
items.title: Newsletter, card
items.description: A card with an image beside the headline and an email capture form.

items.name: newsletter-inline
items.title: Newsletter, inline
items.description: One-line email capture: headline and description beside an email field and a subscribe button.

items.name: newsletter-split
items.title: Newsletter, split
items.description: Copy and a short benefit list on the left, a raised sign-up panel on the right. For a newsletter that needs a reason to subscribe, not just a field.

items.name: newsletter-topics
items.title: Newsletter, choose topics
items.description: A sign-up where readers tick the topics they want (two to six checkbox cards) before giving an email address. Fewer unsubscribes, better targeting.

items.name: price-list
items.title: Price list
items.description: A menu or a list of services with prices: named groups (with an optional note such as serving hours), each item a name, a dotted leader and a price on one line, a short description and up to three tags. Two columns of groups in wide containers. For a café, restaurant, bakery, salon, barber or class passes.

items.name: pricing-aside-tiers
items.title: Pricing, aside tiers
items.description: A narrow headline column (label, heading, lead and a paragraph) beside three plan cards in one row, each with a badge, name, one line, price, checklist and a button at the foot; the middle plan is featured with an accent border. On a phone the headline sits above and the cards stack.

items.name: pricing-bar
items.title: Pricing, bar
items.description: One slim band between two rules: a heading on the left, the price with its period and one button on the right; on a phone they stack and the price and button centre under the heading.

items.name: pricing-comparison
items.title: Pricing, comparison table
items.description: A feature-by-plan table for two to four plans. Cells show a check ("yes"), a dash ("no") or short text.

items.name: pricing-featured
items.title: Pricing, featured
items.description: One tall featured plan card beside shorter plan cards stacked on its right, under a heading; on a phone the cards stack, the featured one first.

items.name: pricing-figure
items.title: Pricing, figure
items.description: One plan on a plain light section, all centred: a small eyebrow, a heading, the price as a giant display figure that fills most of the width, one line of terms and one filled action. The figure scales with the section width, so on a phone it stays on one line.

items.name: pricing-packages
items.title: Pricing, packages
items.description: A grid of three to six packages: name, one line on what you get, how long it takes, a price or the word "Ask" (never a made-up number), an optional flag, a button each, a visible "Examples" tag and an optional monthly line underneath.

items.name: pricing-rows
items.title: Pricing, plan rows
items.description: Plans as full-width rows instead of cards: name and description, up to three highlights as chips, the price, and a button on one line. Easy to scan down, and room for four or more plans. One row can be marked featured.

items.name: pricing-single
items.title: Pricing, single plan
items.description: One plan with a large price, a button and a checklist of what is included.

items.name: pricing-split-rows
items.title: Pricing, split rows
items.description: A pitch on the left (label, heading, lead and two actions) beside plans stacked as rows on the right, each with its name, one line, a short checklist, the price and a button. One row can be featured with a badge and an accent border. On a phone the pitch sits above the rows and each row stacks its price and button under the text.

items.name: pricing-tiers
items.title: Pricing, three tiers
items.description: Up to three plans side by side with price, feature list and a button. One can be featured.

items.name: pricing-toggle
items.title: Pricing, billing toggle
items.description: Up to three plans with a monthly and yearly switch that changes every price. Both prices show while editing.

items.name: pricing-usage
items.title: Pricing, pay as you use
items.description: Usage-based pricing: a rate card (what is metered, per unit, how much is free) beside a worked example bill with line items and a total, so nobody has to do the sum. Use when there is no plan to pick.

items.name: products-action-mosaic
items.title: Products, action mosaic
items.description: A heading with a lead above a six-column mosaic of unequal tiles: a large picture card, narrow text tiles and picture tiles, each with its own button or link inside. Each tile sets its size and whether it has a picture. On a phone the tiles stack in one column.

items.name: products-card-overlap-list
items.title: Products, card over picture beside a list
items.description: A large picture on the left with a card pinned over its lower left corner that holds a label, the heading and two actions, and on the right a lead line above a list of items ruled apart by thin lines, each with an icon, a title and a line. On a phone the picture and its card come first, then the lead and the list.

items.name: products-cover-link-bar
items.title: Products, cover with link bar
items.description: A full-bleed picture with a giant heading and a label at its foot, then a separate bar under it with a row of navigation links at the left and two actions at the right. On a phone the actions wrap under the links.

items.name: products-feature-stack
items.title: Products, feature stack
items.description: A heading above one large product card (picture, badge, name, line, price and two actions) beside a column of two to four small cards, each a square picture with a name, a line and a price. On a phone the large card sits above the column.

items.name: products-featured-split
items.title: Products, featured split
items.description: A heading row, then one product shown whole: a captioned picture on the left, and on the right a badge, name, line, a ticked list of points, the price and two actions. On a phone the picture sits above the details.

items.name: products-grid-picture-foot
items.title: Products, grid with picture foot
items.description: A heading with a lead on the left and two actions on the right, a row of icon cards each with a title, a line and a small link, and one wide captioned picture under the cards. On a phone everything stacks.

items.name: products-oversized-headline
items.title: Products, oversized headline
items.description: A giant headline that runs across the page with a pill picture and a round picture set inline between its words, a lead line beside a picture, a row of three cards each with a picture, a name, a line, check points and a link, and two actions at the end. On a phone the lead and picture stack and the cards run one under the other.

items.name: products-picker
items.title: Products, picker
items.description: A large picture with a label, big heading, lead and two actions on the left, beside a narrow list of item cards on the right, each with a name, an optional label, one line and a price. The first card is marked as current and every card is a plain link. On a phone the list sits under the left side.

items.name: products-picture-chips
items.title: Products, picture and chips
items.description: A wide picture first, then a centred large heading with two actions, then a wrapped centred row of pill links. On a phone the pills wrap onto more lines.

items.name: products-rows
items.title: Products, rows
items.description: A heading over full-width ruled rows, each with a small square picture, a name, one line, a price and a button at the right. The heading can instead sit beside a large picture with plain rows (name, label, line, price) and actions below. On a phone each row stacks its button under the text.

items.name: products-satellite
items.title: Products, satellite
items.description: A centred heading, then one square picture in the middle flanked by a stack of item cards on each side (icon, optional badge, name, line and price), with two actions centred below. On a phone the left cards, the picture and the right cards stack in that order.

items.name: products-slide
items.title: Products, slide
items.description: One large item card per view, a picture beside its label, name, line and price, with a round previous and next arrow at its sides and two actions centred below. The cards sit in a scroll-snap row, so swiping or the arrows move between them with no script. On a phone the picture sits above the text.

items.name: products-stepped-cards
items.title: Products, stepped cards
items.description: Say in one line what it gives the visitor.

items.name: products-sticky-stack
items.title: Products, sticky stack
items.description: A heading block (label, title, lead) that stays pinned at the top while full-width cards slide up beneath it and stack, each card pinned a little lower than the last: icon and step label, name, line, check points and two actions on the left, a picture on the right. Pure CSS, no script; on a phone the card stacks its picture under the text.

items.name: products-tile-links
items.title: Products, tiles with links
items.description: A tall picture tile on the left beside two tiles stacked on the right: a heading tile (label, heading, line) and a tile with a list of navigation links, two actions and a small link. On a phone the three tiles stack.

items.name: products-tile-mosaic
items.title: Products, tile mosaic
items.description: A twelve-column mosaic of tiles in rounded cards where the heading, lead and two actions are the biggest tile. Around it sit a captioned picture, a product tile with badge, name and price, an accent tile with icon, list and price, a big-number tile, an icon tile and a wide picture. On a tablet it is six columns and on a phone one.

items.name: related-content
items.title: Related content
items.description: A shared grid of linked cards for other articles, projects, services, products or events. Images are optional.

items.name: report-audit-modules
items.title: Audit, module scores
items.description: A grid of audit modules with explicit scored, unavailable and pending states; findings stay next to their score.

items.name: report-audit-overview
items.title: Audit, overview
items.description: A scored audit summary with scope, limitations and source provenance. An unassessed result is never rendered as zero.

items.name: report-audit-recommendations
items.title: Audit, recommendations
items.description: Prioritized audit findings with impact, effort, scope, affected pages and a concrete next action.

items.name: report-callout
items.title: Report, callout
items.description: A boxed aside in a report: a note, a tip, a warning or something important. The kind is a word and an icon, never colour alone.

items.name: report-decisions
items.title: Report, decisions
items.description: Numbered decisions for the reader. Each has a question, an optional recommended option, the other options and why, so the answer can be "yes to all except 2". With an id on a card, the reader can answer on the page (see the report kit).

items.name: report-figure
items.title: Report, figure
items.description: A picture in a report, or a gallery of them, shown whole (never cropped, at most 90 % of the screen tall) with an optional title and captions, for decisions that need a visual pick. kh-report embeds a local image file as a data address so the page stays one file; remote addresses are refused there.

items.name: report-header
items.title: Report, header
items.description: The top of a report: what kind it is (Status, Decision, Research), the title, a summary and a few facts (date, author, refs).

items.name: report-prose
items.title: Report, prose
items.description: A headed section of text for everything else in a report: paragraphs, a smaller heading, bulleted and numbered lists, a quote, a code block. **bold**, `code` and [links](https://…) work inside the text.

items.name: report-sources
items.title: Report, sources
items.description: Numbered sources: a label, the address (shown in full) and a note on what it was used for. Only http(s) and mail addresses become links.

items.name: report-stats
items.title: Report, key figures
items.description: Two to six figures at a glance: a value, what it counts, an optional note and a direction (up, down, flat).

items.name: report-steps
items.title: Report, steps
items.description: Steps for the reader to do, in order: the next one open and loud with a button to where it happens, what it unlocks and its time; done steps fold to one line, later ones are small. Done sends the step's words to the seat that owns it (the report kit's answer relay), Later today sends nothing, Skip sends a note.

items.name: report-table
items.title: Report, table
items.description: A table for long cells: the text wraps, and on a narrow screen every row becomes a card with its labels, so nothing scrolls sideways.

items.name: report-timeline
items.title: Report, timeline
items.description: What happened and when: a dated list with a title and a few lines for each entry.

items.name: review-page-note
items.title: Review, page note
items.description: One page of a site review: its name and address, the page as it is now beside what we propose and why, up to five notes marked keep, change, add or remove (said in words, with a shape), and an optional screenshot of the page now with a visible caption. Fields left empty are hidden, never filled with sample text; src/review/map.ts fills them from a Canvas review page (docs/review-blocks.md).

items.name: review-summary
items.title: Review, summary
items.description: The front of a site review: which site, when, how many pages were read, the verdict in a few plain sentences, up to five findings with a severity said in words and the page each is about, what we would build, and two actions (go ahead, ask a question). Fields left empty are hidden, never filled with sample text; src/review/map.ts fills them from a Canvas review record (docs/review-blocks.md).

items.name: rows-alternating
items.title: Rows, picture and text
items.description: A centred heading and line, then one row per place or offer: a wide picture on one side, its name, a small line, a short text and a button on the other. The picture swaps sides row by row; on a phone each row stacks picture first.

items.name: schedule-header-row-list
items.title: Schedule, header row list
items.description: A heading with its label on the left and one or two actions on the right of the same row, a wide picture with a caption across the full width below, then dated entries as cards in a grid, each with a date, time, name, line and tag. On a phone the actions drop under the heading and the cards stack in one column.

items.name: schedule-picture-top-list
items.title: Schedule, picture on top list
items.description: One narrow column: a wide picture with a caption, then a label, heading and lead, then dated rows split by thin lines (date, name and line on the left, time and place on the right), and one or two actions last. On a phone each row stacks its time and place under its text.

items.name: schedule-spine-alternating
items.title: Schedule, spine alternating
items.description: A centred heading over a vertical line down the middle, with a dot per entry and cards alternating left and right of it, then centred actions. An entry holds a date, time, name, line, an optional price with ticks and button, and a pill. On a phone the line moves to the left edge and every card sits on its right.

items.name: schedule-time-rows
items.title: Schedule, time rows
items.description: A heading over ruled rows, each with its time in small mono type at the start, the name of the session and an outlined button at the end. On a phone the time sits over the name and the button under it.

items.name: snapshot-module
items.title: Snapshot, module
items.description: One research module of a snapshot as a card: reading (skeleton), ready (headline, summary, suggestions with priority and effort chips and an impact line, then findings, numbered source markers that link to the sources list in the card), unsure (the note only) or failed (a plain sentence). Data is untrusted text; links open only if http(s), in a new tab with noopener nofollow.

items.name: snapshot-profile
items.title: Snapshot, profile
items.description: A compact card shown first in a snapshot: the site's name, what it does in a few sentences, and its trade, region and language when known. Text only (the data is read from a crawl); an empty field is left out.

items.name: snapshot-progress
items.title: Snapshot, progress
items.description: The live narration of a snapshot: the site being read and its status, the newest line pulsing (motion-safe) and older lines ticked, at most eight in view with the rest under a native "Show all". One polite live region holds only the newest line, so a re-render never re-announces the list. Queued shows the note; done shows a done line.

items.name: sources-list
items.title: Sources list
items.description: The numbered sources behind a snapshot: host and path of each address (the path cut), what kind of source it is said in words, and the day it was fetched. Addresses are untrusted: shown as text, opened only if http(s), in a new tab with noopener nofollow. An empty list draws nothing.

items.name: stats-band
items.title: Stats, accent band
items.description: An edge-to-edge band in the accent colour: a short statement on the left and three or four big figures divided by hairlines on the right. Loud and brief; use it once, between two quiet sections.

items.name: stats-bars
items.title: Stats, bars
items.description: Two to six measures as labelled horizontal bars with the value at the end. The bar length is the number in `value` (0 to 100, any step: 4% draws 4%; the old `fill` prop is ignored); use it for shares and rates, not for raw counts. A value with no number draws no bar.

items.name: stats-cards
items.title: Stats, cards
items.description: Two to four stat cards, each with a large value, a label, a line of context and an optional change badge.

items.name: stats-columns
items.title: Stats, columns
items.description: A heading on the left with a short note on the right, then three to eight vertical bars on a baseline, each with its value above and its label under. The bar height is the first number in `value`, scaled so the largest fills the chart; use it for a week or a few periods. On a phone the heading and note stack and the bars keep their row, narrower.

items.name: stats-figures-inline
items.title: Stats, figures inline
items.description: A dark band with a large heading and a small note, then item names in large italic display type flowing inline like a sentence, each followed by a small figure; on a phone the names wrap onto their own lines.

items.name: stats-rings
items.title: Stats, rings
items.description: Two to four percentages as rings with the figure in the middle, a label and a note under each. The fill is the number in `value` (0 to 100); a value with no number draws an empty ring. For rates and shares, not raw counts.

items.name: stats-row
items.title: Stats row
items.description: A short heading and two to four large figures with labels.

items.name: stats-split
items.title: Stats, split
items.description: Heading and one oversized headline figure on the left, two to four supporting numbers in a hairline grid on the right. Use when one number matters more than the rest.

items.name: steps-horizontal
items.title: Steps, horizontal
items.description: Three to five steps in a single row, on one continuous line with a marker on each. In narrow containers the same line runs down the left as a vertical list. Short steps only; use the timeline for long ones.

items.name: steps-media
items.title: Steps, with image
items.description: A picture on one side that stays in view while three to six numbered steps run down the other. Use when one screenshot explains the whole flow.

items.name: steps-numbered
items.title: Steps, numbered
items.description: Numbered steps as cards in a row or as a list. A step may carry a copyable code block or a reference chip.

items.name: steps-timeline
items.title: Steps, timeline
items.description: A vertical timeline of labelled steps with a connecting line and an optional main action under the last step. Process, onboarding or roadmap.

items.name: team-departments
items.title: Team, by department
items.description: No photos: names and roles listed in columns under department headings, for companies too big for portraits. Optional link to open roles.

items.name: team-featured
items.title: Team, featured
items.description: One person given the stage (large photo, longer bio, a link), then a row of round-portrait cards for everyone else. For a founder-led company.

items.name: team-grid
items.title: Team, grid
items.description: A heading and a grid of people with photo, name, role and a short bio.

items.name: team-list
items.title: Team, list
items.description: People as rows: portrait, name and role, a longer bio and one link. Reads like a directory, good for eight people or fewer with something to say. Leave the link label empty to drop the link.

items.name: testimonial-quote
items.title: Testimonial, quote
items.description: One large pull quote with a name, a role, a company and a portrait; a quote alone (a press line) shows without them.

items.name: testimonials-alternating
items.title: Testimonials, alternating
items.description: A centred eyebrow and heading, then rows that each pair a quote and a name with a picture, the picture switching sides row by row; on a phone each row stacks as quote, name, picture.

items.name: testimonials-carousel
items.title: Testimonials, carousel
items.description: One quote at a time with previous and next buttons. Moves only when pressed; every quote shows while editing.

items.name: testimonials-cover
items.title: Testimonials, cover
items.description: A full-width cover picture under a dark scrim with a big headline over it, and one white quote card (quote, name and role, one button) overlapping its lower part, to the right on a wide screen and full width on a phone. One strong customer quote that opens a page or closes a story.

items.name: testimonials-grid
items.title: Testimonials, grid
items.description: A heading and a grid of quotes, each with a name and role.

items.name: testimonials-list
items.title: Testimonials, list
items.description: A plain heading above a single column of quotes in ruled rows, each with a small round portrait beside the quote and the speaker under it; on a phone the portrait sits above the quote.

items.name: testimonials-rating
items.title: Testimonials, rating
items.description: A review-site look: a big average score with stars and the review count on the left, two to four star-rated reviews with a headline, text, name and date on the right. Stars are decorative; the rating is read out as "5 out of 5 stars". The score card is drawn only when score holds the business's real rating; with no real rating, leave score and basis empty and only the reviews show. With a real rating and no review texts (reviews empty) it is a slim strip: stars, score and count on one line beside the title, and a link to the reviews.

items.name: testimonials-side
items.title: Testimonials, side
items.description: An eyebrow, heading, lead and two actions in a left column, with quote cards stacked in the right column, each with a star rating line, the quote and a round face with name and role. On a phone the cards follow the text in one column.

items.name: testimonials-split
items.title: Testimonials, featured and more
items.description: One long quote on a tinted panel with a portrait, beside a stack of two or three short quotes. A lead story with supporting voices; unlike the wall, the hierarchy is fixed.

items.name: testimonials-three-column
items.title: Name a person
items.description: Three columns: star-rated quote cards stacked on the left, the label, heading, lead and one action centred in the middle, more quote cards on the right. Each card has stars with a rating line, the quote, and the person with initials. On a phone the headline comes after the left quotes in one column.
